noteEncoding.compatibility: Frozen v0.3 pqtc-note-v3 encoding is unchanged and is not exercised by this transcript harness.

applicationDigest.compatibility: Frozen P2BB512-v1 application digest and typed application domains are unchanged; transcript K512 research does not replace application hashing.

applicationMode.compatibility: Frozen rate-4 Poseidon2 application sponge mode, width, capacity, and output width are unchanged.

tree.compatibility: Frozen v0.3 Merkle tree, leaf/node domains, depth, and root representation are unchanged.

publicStatement.compatibility: Frozen four-Digest512 withdrawal statement and its 64 canonical BabyBear public values are retained byte-for-byte.

relation.compatibility: Frozen 256-row, 190-column withdrawal AIR and all constraints are unchanged.

baseField.compatibility: BabyBear modulus and canonical big-endian field encoding remain unchanged.

challengeField.compatibility: Degree-4 BabyBear extension, coefficient basis order, and rejection sampling remain unchanged.

pcs.compatibility: Frozen hiding two-adic FRI PCS, query counts, folding schedule, and grinding parameters are unchanged.

hiding.compatibility: Frozen four random codewords and eight MMCS salt fields per leaf remain unchanged.

mmcs.compatibility: Frozen 512-bit Keccak MMCS commitments, cap width, salts, leaf hashing, and node compression are unchanged.

transcript.compatibility: Production-compatible mode exactly replays frozen v0.3 Transcript512; the separate versioned research mode is not integrated.

proofCodec.compatibility: Frozen v0.3 Part A/B codec and widths are used only as baseline/continuation evidence; no candidate transcript is integrated into or proven compatible with that codec.

evmVerifier.compatibility: Frozen production verifier and pool entry points are untouched; the standalone prefix gas harness is not a verifier replacement.

checkpointModel.compatibility: Frozen checkpoint field layout and A/B position model are reference inputs; alternate transcript states would change checkpoint contents and compatibility is not established.

deploymentManifest.compatibility: Frozen sepolia-v0.3 parameters and deployment manifest remain authoritative; no candidate address, artifact, or deployment is proposed.

blockers: primitive APIs do not enforce the claim/boundary state machine and permit premature sample calls
TypeScript misuse labels are out-of-band rather than a serialized-grammar oracle
Rust/Solidity mutation and cross-language parity execution are absent
full-width continuation redesign is not implemented; identifiers remain bytes32
single-slot key collision overwrite and hashed-record comparison remain unresolved
gate.reason: Retained as the exact comparison control; it is not a new deployment candidate.
